changeSet.author: openelis
changeSet.comment: An organism's default AST panel is the current version of its panel.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE clinlims.micro_organism o SET default_ast_panel_id = cur.id FROM clinlims.micro_ast_panel old JOIN clinlims.micro_ast_panel cur ON cur.logical_key = old.logical_key AND cur.is_current = 'Y' WHERE o.default_ast_panel_id = old.id AND old.is_current = 'N'
